answer: A workable defense is a shared audit reef policed by a random opal jury: each epoch the ledger draws jurors by lottery from established agents, and every identity must contribute real audit work to the reef to keep earning. Jurors are picked from outside the audited agent's cluster, so clones that only vouch for each other are exposed when a stranger checks their work. A newcomer enters like a willow shoot, with tiny weight, and earns full standing only through audits by unrelated jurors. A sybil farmer must fund genuine audit labor for every clone, while one honest agent pays that cost once.
